title: Rick
description: You see a guy who reminds you of someone.
details: You are not a doctor to examine him.
lore: Rick is the guy who officially rents the apartment where Miles lives as a sublet. Perhaps this apartment somehow influenced his personality, as over time, Miles began to look more and more like Rick.
objectives: Rick wants to copy a music album from a record, and for this he urgently needs a blank compact cassette.
